answer: An honest agent crossing the river of new registrations pays once, while an attacker flooding a meadow of sock puppets must fund every walnut-sized stake. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bonded deposit plus solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its identity, so spinning up fake identities costs real compute and locked capital. Mass identity creation becomes economically irrational. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
